caption: The drawing features a single, lidded teapot positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The teapot has a rounded, ribbed body and a matching lid with a small, rounded handle on top. Its body and lid display a brown color with a glazed finish, showing various shades ranging from light brown to darker brown, giving a textured appearance. The ribs are vertically aligned, accentuating the teapot's roundness. The spout extends from the right, curving upward and also colored brown, consistent with the rest of the teapot. There are patches of light gray that appear to represent areas where the glaze has worn off, particularly on the lower half of the body. There are no other objects or details in the background, and the overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the teapot.
title: Posset Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
